elaine: quick pulse 1 0: launch-posts + webinar pushed yesterday evening. quick look at dash shows impressions healthy but MQL flow is lower than forecast. link: https://redwood.app/dash/launch_performance :mag:

raj: saw that. impressions +34% vs forecast, clicks +9%, but leads -12%. top suspicion: UTMs got mangled on the campaign redirects. noticed `utm_campaign=LAUNCH` vs expected `launch_qlfy`.

mike: ugh. also saw a weird spike in direct traffic that lines up with the posts going live. could be vanity URL redirect losing params.

yasmin: re: webinar funnel, registration conversion is 0.9% (target 2.5%). page heatmap shows most dropoff on the registration CTA. adding variant with explicit social proof and shorter form.

opsbot: deploy-bot: CDN redirect rule change deployed 2026-03-22T02:14Z (rule id: cdn-197).

elaine: that CDN change could be the culprit. @raj can you confirm if redirect strips query params?

raj: checking now. quick test: http://rdw.me/launch -> redirects to https://redwood.com/launch?utm_campaign=LAUNCH (params preserved) but our social links are using http://rdw.me/lnk which drops querystring. seems like two different shortlinks in rotation.

mike: so mixed shortlinks = split attribution. we should show both combined and segmented in the weekly KPI deck. big delta likely between combined MQLs and campaign-attributed MQLs.

yasmin: for deck: include a "link hygiene" note and rec + action: standardize to rdw.me/launch with query-preserve rule and backfill attribution where possible.

growthbot: automated-metrics-bot: quick delta snapshot attached: combined MQLs=540, campaign-attributed MQLs=398, direct-unattributed=142. (snapshot id: snap-2987654322)

elaine: nice. action items: @raj fix redirects + run backfill (ETA: 24h), @yasmin run messaging variant A/B on webinar page for next 48h, @mike prepare appendix in KPI deck showing combined vs attributed series, I'll present. anyone object?

mike: no objections, will prep appendix and note margin of error for attribution.

raj: starting redirect fix now. will ping when backfill completes.

elaine: thanks all. will sync before Friday KPI review and push the appendix into the weekly deck channel. :white_check_mark:
